name: Compare CD Rates Calculator
meta_title: Compare CD Rates: Short vs. Long Term CDs
meta_description: Compare two to four CDs with different terms and APYs over the same horizon, with reinvestment and early withdrawal penalties, to find the best one.
subtitle: Line up two to four CDs with different terms and rates over the same stretch of time, and see which one leaves you with the most once shorter CDs are reinvested.
